message.content:
Task #12 GPU validation in /workspace/SuperGrok1.5, single H100, HEAD=642e360. The autotuner was rebuilt offline tonight (commit 84db23f): (1) the winner-timer now times the REAL megakernel TC step when tile dims vary (was GEMM-blind), (2) new search dims tile_m/tile_n/dec_dw_splitk(+vit/mb), (3) per-model nested winner schema. NEVER GPU-validated. Validate it now, BOUNDED.

RUN (the authoring agent's own validation command, decoder first):
  PYTHONPATH=. timeout 3600 python -m grokking_optimizers.compile --optimizer adamw --model decoder --arch sm_90 --cache build/.compile_cache.json --jit-only --mode bayesian --bayesian-trials 60 2>&1 | tee /tmp/tune_dec.log
(60 trials, NOT 300 — bounded validation, not a full search. If a trial-level flag for time budget exists, also cap ~45 min.)
VERIFY in the log: the `[megakernel-tc]` timer lines fire for tile-dim configs (proving the real-step timer is live — grep them); trials complete without crashes; a winner is exported. Inspect grokking_optimizers/_kernel_tuned.json: must be the NESTED {sm_90:{decoder:{adamw:{...}}}} shape. Report the winner's dims + its measured ms vs the default config's ms (the tuner's own numbers).
THEN THE CRITICAL GATE — tuned winners must not break correctness: with the winner json in place, rebuild production (`python setup.py build_ext --inplace` or the build path that injects -DSG_TUNED_*) ONLY IF the winner differs from the defaults; then `python wiring_check.py --require-all` (33/33) + tail-gates `--cell adamw/decoder` + `--cell muon/decoder` + `python -m pytest tests/hw/test_decoder_tc.py -q` (18/18) + A/A/A via the tail-gate. If the winner == defaults (plausible — H1/H3 already hand-tuned this), say so plainly; the validation that the TIMER+SCHEMA work is still the deliverable.
DECISION RULE: if all green AND the winner beats default beyond noise per the bench (`python tuning/decoder_bench.py --d 1024 --B 16384 --reps 3` with the tuned build), COMMIT the _kernel_tuned.json (+ nothing else) as "autotune: ship decoder winner (validated #12 timer+dims on GPU)". If the winner ties/loses or any gate fails: REVERT the json (git checkout/rm), restore the default build, re-verify 33/33, and report the validation outcome honestly (the #12 infrastructure being proven live is itself the success).
Raw outputs (the megakernel-tc grep, the winner dims + numbers, all gate lines) + final tree state + commit hash if any. No report files.

## 2. Rebuild — bake the tuned flags into `_ops*.so`

A plain rebuild now consumes the JSON automatically (no special flag — the old
`./build.sh --autotune` two-pass flow was removed; see §5):

```bash
# editable rebuild (FORCE_CUDA=1 if no visible GPU on the build host)
FORCE_CUDA=1 TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="9.0a" \
    pip install -e . --no-build-isolation -v
# or:  ./build.sh
```

Watch for the build-time notice. With a JSON present you should see lines like:

```
  [tuned-inject] injected per-TU tuned flags into N CUDA TU(s) in build.ninja.
```

With no JSON you should instead see:

```
  [tuned-inject] no _kernel_tuned.json found; building with in-header kernel defaults …
```

# Host-memory guard (#12 GPU validation): honour an operator-set MAX_JOBS /
    # NVCC_THREADS env cap if present, else default to NCPUS / 8. On
    # memory-cgroup-limited hosts the full NCPUS ninja fan-out OOM-kills
    # cc1plus/cicc on the CUTLASS TUs; an outer `MAX_JOBS=N` bounds the fan-out
    # without changing default behaviour when unset.
